stem: The assigned receiving rack is visibly dirty before harvested material arrives. What should happen?
choices: Use the supplied sanitation/out-of-service process before material contacts the rack
Use it because drying will reduce contamination
rationale: Use the supplied sanitation/out-of-service process before material contacts the rack. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
